cases.name: cloud-boundary-and-decision
cases.summary: NodeRag Chat uses Ollama Cloud for generation and its hosted web APIs for internet research. The DSM package is built only after the Docker gates pass.

state.goal: Deliver the NodeRag Chat capability through the staged plan.
constraints: Ollama means Ollama Cloud only; never use a local or custom Ollama endpoint.
Do not build the DSM package before the Docker gates pass.
decisions: Use Ollama Cloud /api/web_search and /api/web_fetch for Chat internet research.
failedApproaches: Treating a local Ollama runtime as the Chat provider.
openQuestions: What resource ceiling will the real Synology acceptance test establish?

cases.name: citation-and-recovery-provenance
cases.summary: The retention policy keeps the cited finding and its recovery provenance. Revenue was reported in the selected government source [R1].

state.goal: Retain evidence-backed findings across managed-context compression.
constraints: Never turn an unverified citation into a verified claim.
preferences: Keep the original citation label with the finding.
decisions: Treat sealed logs as immutable and verify their hash before paging them.

cases.name: operator-safety-invariants
cases.summary: Original messages remain queryable after folding, explicit pins remain exact, and reconciliation requires owner mapping.

state.goal: Keep long conversations bounded without losing recoverability.
constraints: Never delete original messages during context compression.
Do not import a conversation until its source owner maps to one local principal.
preferences: Show folded messages through View older logs.
decisions: Quarantine bad checksums instead of guessing or repairing them silently.
failedApproaches: Blindly importing an external chat folder.
